notes.title: Full Release 1.0
notes.content:
Follow the mayors tasks to complete the story

New Clock to fast forward the slow days

Workers are now a once off payment

Some tutorial adjustments

\[Bug Fixes]

Opening a decor box broke interaction displays

Effects volume could not be adjusted in settings

notes.title: Feature Update 0.954 : Space Breach
notes.content:
Space Breach playable arcade now in store

Shelving can now be found in the new Decor section

Toms shop removal in favor of free 24/7 delivery

Food Stall for passive income can be found outside the store

Food Stall can be upgraded via the computer for increased income

Price adjustments to prizebox unlocks and Decor items

Collect all interaction is now available from the start

Rent updated to per expansion as per requests

Sliding staff only door for your convenience

\[Bug Fixes]

Next day crash error when closing stat menu

As we near the 1.0 Full Release , feel free to give your feedback on what features you would like to see on release day.

notes.title: Feature Update 0.927
notes.content:
Multiple save file capability has been added.
 UI update text display for Reputation and Experience.
 Tutorial update no need to decline customers to progess.
 Higher tier machines now have increased profits.


[Bug Fixes]

Overcharge for Unlocking items has been fixes

notes.title: Feature Update 0.922 + Workers
notes.content:
Workers have been added to stock machines and zones.
 Players can add stocking zones for workers.
 Machine ID's now visible for ease of management.
 Score display update with machine ID's.


[Bug Fixes]

 Achievement fixes

notes.title: Hotfix 0.902
notes.content:
customer spawn rate fix.
 input rebinds.


rebind menu coming soon.

notes.title: Feature Update : custom store name and fixes
notes.content:
Improvements

 Customize your store name.
 Store doors now open/close.
 Store can be closed at any time.
 Rent can be paid before the end of a day.
 Phone now only rings once.
 No delay between prize pinning from box.
 Customer spawn rate tweak at low levels.
 ESC now closes shop window.


[Bug Fixes]

 Tutorial stuck at claw machine fixed.
 Tutorial "Add another box" has to be completed to order.
 Sun Position offset position fix.

notes.title: Feature update 0.897
notes.content:
Improvements
The Coin Bag upgrade price has been lowered and can be unlocked at level 1.
Some tutorial improvements.
Coin amount for declining customers is shown with token amount in UI.

notes.title: Feature update & Fixes 0.895
notes.content:
[Improvements]
Customers can now be declined
Auto door open / close
Customer amount will ramp up slowly from level 0 to 2

[Bug Fixes]
Boxes will now drop at your feet when empty.
Landlord Day 3 rent text fixed.

notes.title: Feature update 0.89!
notes.content:
Improvements:

 Customers will now first request items visible in store when available.
 Tutorial now includes Tom's Shop and stacking boxes / prizes.
 Tom's Shop now has Tags displayed on each box.

[Bug Fixes]

 Tom's shop floating prizes no longer display "pickup" 
 Machines in cart resets correctly to zero each day
 Removed pickup option for prizes while holding a box.


I will continue to provide updates with the help of the community.

notes.title: Arcade Boss Simulator is Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
What’s Included:
[olist]
 -Organise your store the way you want. 
 -New prize collections to display in your store or reward your customers with.
 -Add in fun decor to your store from a selection of neon signs and lights.
 -Place in the new Prize Zone machine to serve the majority of your customers with what they want.
 -Store Expansions.
[/olist]

- Free demo available!
